guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.intro: OREVOSH is about clothes, not bodies. Here is what keeps it that way.
guidelines.rule1: Comments are about the outfit: fit, color, proportion, the shoes. Nothing about anyone's body, face, weight, age or gender. The stylist follows the same rule.
guidelines.rule2: You confirmed you are at least 16. Looks that appear to show a child are removed.
guidelines.rule3: Post yourself, or people who agreed to be posted. No screenshots of other people's photos, no nudity.
guidelines.rule4: A brand's own looks are marked. Product tags link to the brand's own site. Challenges are decided by votes, not by the brand.
guidelines.rule5: Three reports hide a look or a comment until a moderator has seen it. Repeat offenders are suspended.
guidelines.privacy: Your checks are private until you post them. The stylist's tip and breakdown stay yours even after you post. Delete your account in Settings and everything goes: photos, clips, looks, comments, follows.
